#residentevil, One of the most talked about rumors about Resident Evil 9 is that it could be the most ambitious project in the franchise’s history. Reports from industry insiders claim Capcom originally tested a semi open world structure before refining the concept into something more focused and story driven. The development cycle is said to be longer than previous entries because the team wants it to feel like a true next generation evolution rather than just a sequel. Another interesting detail is that RE9 is rumored to lean more heavily into psychological horror again, scaling back some of the action heavy pacing seen in later titles. If true, it could mark a tonal shift that brings the series closer to its survival horror roots while still keeping cinematic intensity at the forefront.
